lines.line: How it works: the invisible cast.
Everything on the wall is a real shadow, cast by one lamp.
Her body, her hair, her cloak, and the chair, are all real 3D objects.
But they write no colour and no depth. You never see them. They only cast shadows.
They stand between the lamp and the wall, scaled toward the light, so the shadows land at just the right size.
Even the credit line is a shader. Each letter is inked black or white, by whatever is behind it.
